actions.action: Block aegean-edu.com.tr and lookalike domains at the email gateway; retroactively search mail logs for identical subject lines and recipients.
Review sign-in and mailbox access logs for n.guler@aegean.edu; force password revocation if anomalous access is found after delivery.
Issue a campus phishing advisory warning about fake payroll/IBAN update lures and reinforce reporting procedures.

limitations: Single confirmed finding with no observed abuse chain or downstream compromise.

contrastive.explanation: Rejecting F1 as unsupported would leave zero surviving signals and the policy would call this benign.

risk.rationale: Verified evidence consists only of F1 (CONFIRMED 0.8): a phishing-suspect email delivered from aegean-edu.com.tr to n.guler@aegean.edu with a payroll/IBAN-update lure (T1566.002 spearphishing). This is a confirmed exposure — malicious/suspect mail reached a real university account — but the verified record contains no evidence of a completed account takeover chain (no credential entry, no compromised session, no post-compromise mailbox/sending activity). It cannot be called benign because the signal is not explained away, and it is not a weak unexplained signal (F1 is CONFIRMED at 0.8), so monitor does not fit. Contain is not supported on verified evidence alone because an account-takeover chain is not confirmed. Human review is needed to scope containment (quarantine/block sender, password reset, user outreach) given the IBAN-fraud lure.
escalate_reasons: signals of compromise without a confirmed abuse chain
